en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Safar narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from `Ali b. al-Hakam from Aban al-Ahmar from Salih b. Maytham from Abi Ja`far al-Baqir (as). He said:
There is not a man who bears false witness over the wealth of a Muslim man to cut him off except that Allah decrees a place for him in the Fire.
